0022600095.text: Neither the Indiana Pacers nor the Dallas Mavericks has played a 2026-27 game yet. The Pacers, at home, are without Aaron Nesmith (hamstring strain), Johnny Furphy (knee surgery) and T.J. McConnell (hamstring), while Dallas is missing Caleb Martin (thumb sprain), Dereck Lively II (foot surgery), Jett Howard (calf), Santi Aldama (knee) and Tarik Biberovic (heel). The Pacers lost both regular season meetings in 2025-26, most recently 134-130 on February 22, 2026 in Indianapolis, and no games have been played in the 2026-27 season series so far.
